FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Heat & Cool Solutions, we specialize in comprehensive heating and refrigeration services for both residential and small commercial clients. Our core operations include installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency. All our technicians are certified and licensed, adhering to strict safety protocols and regulations to guarantee compliance and protect our clients' interests. We focus on delivering quality service with a proactive approach, including preventive maintenance programs to minimize emergency repair needs. Our fleet of well-maintained service vehicles is equipped with safety tools and GPS tracking for efficient service delivery. We also maintain established supplier relationships for timely access to high-quality HVAC parts and refrigerants, ensuring we can meet client needs promptly. Furthermore, we prioritize continuous training for our staff and conduct regular safety meetings to reinforce a culture of safety and excellence within our operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a refrigeration unit malfunctioned while servicing a commercial client's HVAC system, resulting in a loss of $1,200 due to equipment repair costs. The claim has been settled and marked as closed. Additionally, on August 1, 2023, a technician suffered a minor injury while performing routine maintenance, leading to a $1,300 workers' compensation claim, which is currently in review.
